connector.name: Email Verifier
connector.registryDescription: Verify email deliverability & find business emails (single or bulk) via the Verifox API.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.verifox.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package verifox-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.verifox, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
